items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 23 May 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, while high pressure covers mainland Europe, with another high centre developing off the southwest of England today.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally touching 5 in the south of the area this evening and overnight, but falling Variable 3 or less in the southeast.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south this evening and overnight, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, but Variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow evening, then 3 or less overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any mist.
